data.narrative:
Ayar Labs, a Series E AI & Software company founded by Mark Wade and Vladimir Stojanovic, has raised $870M+ and carries a current post-money valuation of $3.8B. The valuation peer set comprises 9 comparables (1 public, 8 private) in the same sector and stage band, including SandboxAQ ($5.8B, Series E), Wayve ($8.6B, Series D), and Applied Intuition ($15.0B, Series F).

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression modeling, anchored to the $3.8B last post-money valuation and applying a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical of Series E advancement, implies $5.2B. Peer-median triangulation across the 3-company comp set (range: $5.8B–$15.0B) yields a median of $8.6B, reflecting the wide dispersion in current market valuations for frontier AI firms at adjacent stages.

The two methods triangulate to a range of $4.5B (low) to $9.9B (high), with a median of $6.9B. This implies the current $3.8B valuation sits materially below median peer multiples, though within the lower quartile of the observable comp set. Key uncertainties include the stage-specific premium applicable to the next funding round and whether frontier AI valuation multiples will compress given market conditions. The wide peer range ($5.8B–$15.0B) reflects heterogeneous investor expectations across the sector.
